svg.title: Reasoning after game-based RL: Play to Generalize

cc:Work.dc:title: Reasoning after game-based RL: Play to Generalize
cc:Work.dc:description: Redrawn from Xie et al., Play to Generalize, arXiv 2506.08011v4, Table 2. Qwen2.5-VL-7B before and after ViGaL Snake plus Rotation RL: MathVista 68.0% to 71.9%; MathVerse 49.0% to 52.4%; MathVision 26.0% to 27.5%. After-RL error bars are the reported standard deviations over three runs: 0.4, 0.2 and 0.3 percentage points respectively. Baseline variability is not reported. All three benchmarks use a 0–100 percent axis. This is a selected math evaluation, not evidence of transfer to game engines or physical systems.
